text:
devon: quick sync — need to lock down the traffic/metric surface for per-model SLO dashboards. P50/P95/P99 + TTFT + tokens/sec. Who owns canonical metric names?
maria: we should follow the existing metric taxonomy but add `model` & `route` tags. e.g., `inference.latency_ms` w/ percentiles and `inference.tokens_per_sec`.
sarah: +1. runtime can emit percentiles for short windows but we prefer raw histograms to compute p95 server-side.
aj: histograms preferred. exposing percentiles from runtime causes rollup issues. sample rate? we can do 1% default.
kevin: product: need TTFT per-route for SLAs. TTFT = time to first token from request start. Add `ttft_ms` metric and a `ttft_sampled` trace flag.
ian: obs: agree on names: `route.inference.latency_ms` tags: `model`, `route`, `region`, `capacity_tier`. Histogram buckets 0-2000ms, and we emit counts for rollups.
maria: can runtime include `request_id` for traces and a `route_key` tag? else console can't link traces to route.
sarah: yes, runtime will add `route_key` and `model_id`. example payload:
```
metric: inference.latency_ms
value: 120
tags: model_id:vicuna-13b, route_key:chat.create, region:us-west1
```
aj: need to decide sampling for TTFT traces. suggest 0.1% for normal, 1% for errors and for requests above p99.
kevin: dashboard UX: want a "compare models" toggle and rollup by route. Panels: P50/P95/P99, TTFT median & p95, tokens/sec heatmap, and rate-limited error-rate.
devon: runtime infra question — tokens/sec: do we calculate tokens/sec per-request (runtime) or via aggregate counters (ingest)? which is cheaper for storage?
ian: aggregate counters are cheaper: emit `route.tokens_count` and `route.requests_count` per-minute. dashboards can compute tokens/sec. keep counter tags consistent.
maria: ownership: infra emits metrics, obs owns ingest mapping and schema, console owns panels + UX. we'll add a handoff doc in docs/ and link PRs. action items: infra schema PR, obs ingest mapping, console panel draft.
deploy-bot: deployment started by sarah at 2033003490 :rocket: (runtime/metrics-v2)
devon: scheduling 30m cross-team handoff tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll create the doc and the initial PRs.
